title: A building made like a product.
standfirst: SpaCyPhy Tech is an incubatee of the Foundation for Science Innovation and Development at IISc. It wants buildings, rooms and furniture to be made the way products are made: modular, reconfigurable and built for reuse, and to become a new kind of real-estate asset.

hero.alt: Fabrication work in the ARTPARK workshop
hero.caption: Fabrication in the ARTPARK workshop. ARTPARK photograph, not of SpaCyPhy.

lead: Most buildings are static. They are built on site, and once finished, their rooms and furniture rarely change. SpaCyPhy starts from the opposite idea: that a building can behave more like a manufactured product, in build quality, performance, circularity, reusability and the experience of the people who use it.
If that works, a room stops being a fixed address and becomes an asset that can be reconfigured, moved and traded. That is the new real-estate asset class the company says it is building.

quote.text: Buildings are still made one at a time, as if each were the first. We want rooms and structures that are designed, made and reused the way products are.
quote.who: Dr. Vishal Singh, Director, Product Development, SpaCyPhy

blocks: SpaCyPhy combines 3D volumetric, modular construction with plug-and-play cyber-physical infrastructure, bringing construction technology and property technology together. Its stated principles are design for manufacturing and assembly, mass timber, and modularity across a building’s life.

panel.title: What SpaCyPhy offers
items: Desks that turn into dining tables, and work pods that become conference rooms.
Complete reconfigurable units, offered as transactable, investment-ready assets.

blocks: The Foundation for Science Innovation and Development (FSID) at IISc lists SpaCyPhy as an incubatee. The company’s website names four directors, who lead product development, operations, business development and supply chain.
SpaCyPhy is part of ARTPARK’s startup portfolio.

sources: FSID, IISc, SpaCyPhy Tech Private Limited incubatee page
